def.brief: Red before the build, run by chongdae on the standalone project test (not unittest discovery): `python3 test_running_agent.py` and the same under python3.11 (the >=3.11 floor) must exit non-zero having RUN a non-zero number of tests, ending 'FAILED (failures=N)' with no ERROR entries, ImportError, ModuleNotFoundError or NameError — i.e. assertion failures only. Each check passes exactly when the suite is red for the right reasons on the unfixed mangsang.py. Nothing in the tree changes.
checks: import re,subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run([sys.argv[1],'test_running_agent.py'],capture_output=True,text=True); out=r.stdout+r.stderr; print('\n'.join(l for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith(('FAIL:','ERROR:','Ran ','FAILED','OK')))); m=re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests?',out); ok=r.returncode!=0 and bool(m) and int(m.group(1))>0 and re.search(r'FAILED \(failures=\d+\)',out) is not None and not re.search(r'^ERROR:|ImportError|ModuleNotFoundError|NameError',out,re.M); print('red for the right reasons' if ok else 'NOT a clean red'); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

self-performed.why: records the standalone red run before the build as a chongdae-run check: the tests task has no check of its own, and a unittest-discovery exit alone would not show the suite ran
